name: No browser beyond Chrome, Safari and Firefox
description: Web filtering. Chrome and Firefox can be held to a web filtering policy, and Safari cannot be removed, so every other browser that is installed is a way around whatever web filtering is in place. Each row names a browser that was found.
query: SELECT name, bundle_identifier, path FROM apps WHERE bundle_identifier IN ('com.vivaldi.Vivaldi', 'com.brave.Browser', 'company.thebrowser.Browser', 'com.operasoftware.Opera', 'com.microsoft.edgemac', 'org.chromium.Chromium', 'app.zen-browser.zen', 'com.kagi.kagimacOS', 'com.duckduckgo.macos.browser');
